name: Inferno pistol
body:
Source Pathfinder #85: Fires of Creation pg. 60
Statistics
Cost 5,000 gp
Type one-handed ranged; Proficiency exotic (firearms); Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Damage Type F; Critical x2
Range 30 ft.; Capacity 1 nanite canister; Usage 1 charge; Special Touch
Description
An inferno pistol is a less refined variant of the longer-range laser pistolTG. Unlike a laser pistol, which uses an intensely focused beam of light to burn a target, an inferno pistol is much less elegant—it generates a blob of molten, red-hot material and fires what appears to be a burning pellet of fire with a soft hissing sound. This material is consumed swiftly in firing, leaving behind nothing but ash and painful burns on anything it strikes. On a critical hit, a shot from an inferno pistol also inflicts 1 point of burn damage (Reflex DC 12 negates). An inferno pistol has a maximum range of 5 increments.
Construction
Craft DC 21; Cost 2,500 gp
Craft Technological Arms and Armor, nanotech lab
